status_at_freeze: no output generation or scans; corpus preparation complete
hypothesis: A distinct drafting method may improve prose and reduce a commercial detector signal while preserving all claims.
design: Four fresh, same-model writers each produce both development answers. Baseline current installed skill; three candidate procedures screened using independent masked quality review. A separate score-blind selector chooses exactly one globally eligible method before any scan. This is a manual method pilot, not a run of the controller CLI.
writer_settings: Inherited parent model and effort for every fresh-context writer; exact runtime model identifier not exposed by tool metadata.
quality_gate: Every claim and protected literal preserved, no unsupported assertion, professional and relevant; candidate at least as readable as baseline on both development cases. Any failed output makes that method ineligible; all outputs retained.
selection: Separate selector sees methods and masked quality findings, never detector results; choose one eligible method globally by clarity gains across cases, then simpler method as tie-break. If none eligible, stop without scans.

primary_detector.order: technical baseline, technical selected, business selected, business baseline; confirm pair order reversed
primary_detector.preflight: Obtain and save all four full-input UI quotes before first development submission; reject unaffordable complete phase. Reconcile actual remaining credits after every scan. Never buy or bypass limits.

primary_endpoint: Native document label (AI Generated, AI Assisted, Human Written) and separately displayed fully-AI text percentage. Unshown percentages remain null. These are detector signals, not authorship truth. Short-text warnings preserved.
development_advance: Both candidate answers pass quality and are no worse than baseline. At least one pair has a better native label (AI Generated to AI Assisted or Human Written; AI Assisted to Human Written), or at least 5 percentage points lower explicitly displayed fully-AI fraction. Neither pair may have a worse native label or an increase in a comparable displayed fully-AI fraction. Missing incomparable values are not imputed; a within-label fraction comparison needs both values. Unknown labels make advancement indeterminate.

secondary_detector.comparison: baseline versus globally selected method, irrespective of Pangram result; whole pair must fit actual UI quote; do not shorten or truncate
secondary_detector.endpoint: AI, mixed, human confidence separately; comparable baseline required for reduction

holdout: Two existing untouched held-out cases. Root, method authors and writers have not read them at freeze. Release only after primary development advance criterion; fresh same-setting writers, masked review and four complete Pangram submissions. No method changes after release.
promotion: Only consider adding a method after passing development and confirmation quality/detector criteria. Report small synthetic corpus, LLM quality judge and vendor limitations; no universal efficacy or human authorship claims. Negative outcomes retained.
publication: No GitHub answers or public comments in this experiment. Raw UI/account data private; any public study export sanitized.
separate_voice_branch: Optional authentic user sample requested; absent at freeze. Not part of this test.
